verdict.rationale: Lovable's built-in Cloud backend explicitly includes edge functions, database, and auth (lovable-docs-27, lovable-docs-31), and general 'integrations' are mentioned as part of what Lovable generates (lovable-docs-1). However, there is no concrete evidence of specific third-party integrations like Stripe/payments or email providers being wired up from the builder — the closest integration evidence is generic MCP/agent integrations (lovable-docs-8, lovable-docs-26), not payments or email. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of payment gateway integration (e.g., Stripe), email service integration (e.g., Resend/SendGrid), and independent confirmation these work end-to-end.
